## [Worst Online Purchase Experience](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65ef2397831463e8add1300b)
As other customers mentioned this business is not oriented to cater for customers beyond purchase it is more of a marketing company to sell and that is about it. No customer service number rather a message center in which you have to wait for replies. I am sleeping on the floor currently as the bed I order came with missing parts and therefore had to message customer service so it will takes days to get a response back and days if they ship the parts...therefore days I sleep on the floor. Chat customer service is not a live chat as they make you write a message in the end to get back to in days.

March 11, 2024

Unprompted review

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 11, 2024

Hi Monica,

Thank you so much for reaching out and sharing your concerns with us. We're genuinely disheartened to hear about the inconvenience you've experienced with your recent order that arrived on 2/13. It's come to our attention that you contacted us yesterday during our off hours, and we want to assure you that your issue is now our top priority.

We're currently delving into the specifics of your order to understand what went wrong and how we can rectify the situation as swiftly as possible. A member of our team will be in touch shortly to address the missing part and discuss the next steps with you. 

In the meantime, should you have any more questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at support@luluandgeorgia.com. We're here to help and ensure that your experience with us is nothing short of excellent.
